t: A cheap Pi-sized Rockchip board with Wi-Fi 6 and a PCIe connector.
steps: Buy the board from the Pine64 store or ameriDroid in the US.
Get a 5 V 3 A power supply with a 3.5 by 1.35 mm barrel plug.
Get a microSD card and an HDMI cable.
Download the Android 13 image from the Pine64 releases page.
Flash the image with a free tool such as balenaEtcher.
Plug in HDMI and power, then set up Wi-Fi on the screen.
Solder the 40-pin header before you wire any sensors.
Check the Pine64 forum for community Linux images.
meta: Open Board. From $19.99. A few stores.
